finding: An empty release-bindings01.json permits acceptance of an uncommitted RELEASE_REVIEW.json: the review fields are inspected but the review is absent from the committed-body loop.
reproduction: CHECK01.json positive fake-entry case used release-bindings01.json={} and a local uncommitted review. It passed at the exact full-scratch threshold; fake Git show covered only bound.txt.
impact: The source/entry's advertised committed independent-review gate is optional unless release binding membership is enforced.
minimal_fix: Require the exact current RELEASE_REVIEW.json, RELEASE_REVIEW.md and bindings.json paths in the release table, then retain existing current-byte and committed-byte verification.
